risks.risk: Not actually working (no power, dead display, dead speakers, or faulty outputs).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the keyboard powered on, display lit, and at least one sound playing through the built-in speaker or headphone output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified/possibly not working (worst case: treat as needing testing/repair).

risks.risk: Some keys/buttons may be faulty (common with used keyboards).
risks.proof: A video showing a full key sweep (left-to-right) and pressing multiple buttons/controls while the display changes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be key/control issues (worst case: partial faults).

risks.risk: Screen/display may be dim, broken, or unreadable.
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of the display while powered on (showing readable characters).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if display may be unreliable (worst case: assume display not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete package (power adapter, sustain pedal, etc.).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out (power cable/adapter, pedals, manuals if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the keyboard is included (worst case: no adapter/pedals).

proof_requests: Send a video: power ON + display lit + play a few notes/sounds (built-in speaker or headphone).
Send a video: press a full range of keys (left-to-right) and show the display responding.
Send a clear close-up of the display while powered on.
List and show all included items (power adapter, sustain pedal, cables).
response.reason: The model label 'PSR-550' is visible, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' claim has no remote proof (no power-on/playing evidence). Without a working test clip, the safe worst-case pricing requires verification.
